subject.title: [Bug]: Mattermost interaction token forgeable via hardcoded HMAC derivation key

question: What permanent Mattermost interaction signing-secret model should replace bot-token-derived signing for existing and new deployments?
rationale: The security direction is clear, but the durable credential path affects setup, docs, SecretRef handling, upgrade behavior, and whether existing deployments fail closed after restart.

options.title: Require Durable Provisioning
options.body: Land only after the signing secret is configured or persisted through supported setup, SecretRef or doctor paths, docs, and restart/split-process tests.

options.title: Accept Explicit Fail-Closed Setup
options.body: Require operators to configure an interaction secret and make missing-secret failure clear in runtime errors, docs, and tests before merge.

options.title: Sponsor A Replacement PR
options.body: Pause the dirty linked branch and sponsor a narrow replacement once the credential model is chosen.

recommendation.title: Require Durable Provisioning
recommendation.body: Land only after the signing secret is configured or persisted through supported setup, SecretRef or doctor paths, docs, and restart/split-process tests.
